/* common.file.selectAttchFile */
SELECT FILE_SEQ ,FILE_ID , DOC_ID , FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE , FILE_EXTSN_NM AS FILE_EXT_NM , FILE_PARTN_COURS AS FILE_RLTV_PATH , FILE_ABSLT_COURS AS FILE_ASLT_PATH , CNTNTS_TY AS CONTENT_TYPE , SORT_ORDR AS SRT_ORD , REGISTER_NO AS RGSTP_ID , REGIST_DT AS RGST_DTTM , FILE_PARTN_COURS AS IMAGE_URL FROM tb_file WHERE FILE_ID = #{file_id} ORDER BY SORT_ORDR
